subject: Weekly forecast submit + preflight docket (7 Dec)
body:
Message 1/4
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: finance+procurement@astrahealth.com
Date: Thu, 7 Dec 2028 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Weekly forecast submit + preflight docket (7 Dec)

Team —

Quick week-start pulse: please submit updated forecast rows and stage changes for any opportunities in the AST-4521 corridor by EOD Friday (12/8). Key asks:

- Confirm commit/non-commit status for deals > $50k.
- Update Stage to either "Commit" / "Commit: At Risk" / "Pullback" where applicable.
- Attach the minimal evidence packet listed below to the record and drop the packet in the Drive folder (link below).

Attachments included: 2028-Q4-forecast-template.xlsx (template), call-agenda-20281207.md (agenda), AstraHealth-evidence-request.pdf (evidence checklist).

Evidence checklist (short):
- Latest SOW/PO draft or procurement email thread (PDF).
- Decision maker names + expected sign date.
- Any open pricing/term blockers and who owns the action.

Preflight cadence: 10am PT Friday I will run a 20-min slot to triage late-stage accounts. Please bring any last-minute intel to that call. Call link in Drive agenda.

Why this matters: Finance needs the clean numbers for Friday close to lock Q4 run rate. If your account is already locked, mark it "Closed" and add a one-line note with closure date.

Thanks —
Jonas
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: 2028-Q4-forecast-template.xlsx (Excel, 34 KB)]
[Attachment: call-agenda-20281207.md (Markdown, 3 KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 7 Dec 2028 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Weekly forecast submit + preflight docket (7 Dec)

Got it — thanks. A couple quick clarifications before the preflight: 

1) For AST-4521 (AstraHealth) we currently have a verbal PO but legal is still redlining. Do you want this flagged as "Commit: At Risk" or left in "Negotiation" until we have the signed SOW?
2) The evidence checklist references "procurement email thread (PDF)" — should CS upload their email export or should we ask Astra to upload signed docs directly to the Drive folder?

I will add the current SOW draft as a PDF to the Drive now.

Message 3/4
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 8 Dec 2028 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Weekly forecast submit + preflight docket (7 Dec)

Marissa —

Flag AST-4521 as "Commit: At Risk" until we have a signed SOW. We need the signed doc for Finance to recognize revenue in Q4. If legal indicates sign-by date within the quarter and there's a concrete PO, include the expected sign date in the HubSpot notes.

Regarding uploads: please have CS/AE upload a redacted export of the procurement thread (PDF) to the Drive folder. If Astra is comfortable, they can also drop the SOW into the shared folder, but don’t rely on that. 

Agenda for the 10:00am PT preflight (Friday):
- 10:00 — Quick lane-by-lane snapshot (Jonas)
- 10:05 — AST-4521 deep-dive (Marissa; 6 min)
- 10:12 — Top 3 at-risk deals and owners (Grace; 8 min)
- 10:20 — Action item capture and who-own (Ben; 5 min)

Please upload evidence before 9:30am PT so I can triage.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example
HubSpot: https://hubspot.example/deal/AST-4521

Thanks —
Jonas
[Attachment: AstraHealth-evidence-request.pdf (PDF, 28 KB)]

Quick ack — I uploaded the procurement thread PDF and a short note on next steps for AST-4521 to the Drive (folder above).

I also added a one-line action: follow up with Astra procurement (Rahul) for a Monday confirm. If we hear back and get a verbal confirm before EOD Friday, I will ping here with an update and reclassify to "Commit".

Ben
